description: Consumer-side gate criteria for docs_governance.py reports. The tool emits facts and gates only on mechanical ERRORs; a consumer (CI rule, platform step-gate) decides which signals to escalate. This file travels inside the skill so any target repository uses the same criteria.

escalatable_signals.BASELINE_NOT_APPLICABLE: first run has no tracked roster; a consumer that requires an established docs system may gate
escalatable_signals.CONFIRMATION_BASELINE_LOST: declared pass but proposal/checklist missing; an audit-trail-requiring consumer may gate
escalatable_signals.PRESET_UNAVAILABLE: canonical preset absent; a consumer that requires the preset may gate
escalatable_signals.EXEC_CHECKLIST_NOT_DECLARED: validate ran with no pass topic; a consumer that requires a full pass may gate (issue #264)
escalatable_signals.RENAME_AWAITING_CONFIRMATION: git-detected rename not yet confirmed in the proposal's moves; a consumer that requires Human-confirmed renames may gate (issue #275)
escalatable_signals.FACT_NO_SINGLE_HOME: map-covered pages share one heading and none declares authority: primary; a consumer that enforces one-home-per-fact may gate (issue #275 Fix 5). Coarse filter: verify the duplication is a real fact conflict before acting
escalatable_signals.PARALLEL_ONTOLOGY_SUSPECTED: an active page outside the map coverage overlaps covered headings; a parallel docs system may be forming (issue #275 Fix 5). Coarse filter: the remedy is to map, derive, or retire the page, not to delete it on this signal alone
escalatable_signals.UNMAPPED_PAGE: a long-lived markdown page under docs/<category>/ resolves from no map link; the page is invisible to every map-anchored check (baseline pre-flight, 2026-11-20). Coarse filter: the remedy is to register, reclassify, or retire the page, never to delete it on this signal alone
escalatable_signals.ORPHAN_PAGE: a map entry declaring a non-primary role receives no inbound relation edge (issue #275 Fix 7). Fail-open by design: undeclared-role entries are the architecture layer's PAGE_ROLE_UNDECLARED concern; a consumer that requires full graph navigation may gate

never_gate_signals.PRESET_DIVERGENCE: permitted target-repo divergence; escalating would punish legitimate customisation
never_gate_signals.EXEC_STEP5_FINGERPRINT_MISMATCH: in-pass self-certification; evidence is not external to the executor (P0 invariant)

never_gate_reason: These are either explicitly permitted deviations or self-certified values. Escalation requests for them are rejected and reported, never silently applied.

usage.default: gate on error_codes + error_prefixes; all signals pass
usage.escalate: --escalate CODE repeats for each signal the consumer chooses to gate
usage.input: report JSON on stdin (pipe docs_governance.py --validate output directly)
